entries.title: Put several repositories in one project
entries.body: A project can now hold more than one repository, such as an app and its service. Open a project in Settings › Projects and use Add a repository, or ask your first mate to add one to a project. Its tasks take the project's task key, and a task's record names the project with the repository it works in. Each repository keeps its own Ask before merging and Rigor settings, and a project of several gets a name of its own.
